cities.name: Nicosia
cities.local_food_tip: Try veggie meze options, halloumi dishes, salads, lentil soups and olive-based Mediterranean plates — light and flavorful.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏛️ Cyprus Museum (Exterior): Archaeological treasures + quiet gardens. → 🏘️ Old Town Ledra Quarter: Stone alleys, workshops, charming corners. → ☕ Local Café: Cypriot coffee or fresh juice. 

Afternoon: 🌿 Venetian Walls Walk: Historic defensive walls and viewpoints. → 🏰 Famagusta Gate (Exterior). → 🍽️ Lunch: Veg meze, halloumi, salads, dips. → 🎨 Street-art corners around the old streets. 

Sunset: 🌅 Ledra Lookout Terrace: Warm colors over rooftops. 

Night: 🌃 Old-town pedestrian zone: Dessert cafés, soft lights, relaxed evening vibe.

ideas: 🍁 Soft golden tones in old alleys

public_transport_tips: 🚕 Taxis are common for cross-city transport.

city_events.name: Nicosia Festival
city_events.description: 🎭 Theatre, music and cultural performances across the city.

cities.name: Ayia Napa
cities.local_food_tip: Fresh salads, veggie gyros, stuffed vegetables, halloumi dishes and fruit bowls — perfect for a sunny coastal vibe.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏖️ Nissi Beach: Crystal-clear water + soft sand. → 🌿 Coastal Boardwalk: Light walk along the turquoise shoreline. → ☕ Beach Café. 

Afternoon: 🏘️ Ayia Napa Center: Shops, murals, photogenic corners. → 🌿 Sculpture Park (Exterior): Sea views + modern art. → 🍽️ Lunch: Veg gyros, salads, halloumi plates. → 🌊 Harbor Walk. 

Sunset: 🌅 Sea Caves Viewpoint. 

Night: 🌃 Marina promenade: Gelato, crepes, peaceful seaside atmosphere.
public_transport_tips: 🚌 Buses run between beaches + town center.

cities.name: Larnaca
cities.local_food_tip: Larnaca je poznata po mediteranskim jelima: veggie meze, hummus, halloumi, aromatične salate i sveže povrće.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌊 Finikoudes Beach Walk: Palm-lined promenade. → 🏛️ St. Lazarus Church (Exterior). → ☕ Promenade Café. 

Afternoon: 🏘️ Old Turkish Quarter: Artisan corners, quiet streets. → 🌿 Larnaca Salt Lake (Viewpoint). → 🍽️ Lunch: Veg meze, grilled veggies, hummus plates. → 🐦 Hala Sultan Tekke (Exterior). 

Sunset: 🌅 Mackenzie Beach. 

Night: 🌃 Finikoudes evening walk: Ice cream + warm lights.

city_events.name: Larnaca Kataklysmos Festival
city_events.description: 🌊 Water-themed festival with music and cultural events.

cities.name: Limassol
cities.local_food_tip: Veggie meze, stuffed grape leaves, salads, halloumi plates and olive-based dishes — savršena kombinacija svežine i ukusa.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌊 Limassol Promenade: Long palm-lined seaside path. → 🏰 Limassol Castle (Exterior). → ☕ Marina Café. 

Afternoon: 🏘️ Old Town: Colorful alleys + street art. → 🌿 Municipal Gardens. → 🍽️ Lunch: Veg meze, grilled vegetables, salads. → 🎨 Limassol Marina Art Corners. 

Sunset: 🌅 Marina sunset views. 

Night: 🌃 Seaside dessert stands + calm lights.
public_transport_tips: 🚌 Good bus network along the coast.

cities.name: Paphos
cities.local_food_tip: Fresh salads, veggie moussaka, halloumi, stuffed vegetables and Mediterranean dips — lagano i aromatično.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏛️ Paphos Archaeological Park (Exterior areas). → 🏺 Tombs of the Kings (Exterior). → ☕ Harbor café. 

Afternoon: 🌊 Paphos Harbor Promenade. → 🏘️ Old Town Market Streets. → 🍽️ Lunch: Veg meze, moussaka, salads. → 🌿 Lighthouse viewpoints. 

Sunset: 🌅 Coral Bay viewpoint. 

Night: 🌃 Harbor evening walk: Ice cream + calm waters.
public_transport_tips: 🚌 Reliable bus routes to beaches + center.

city_events.name: Paphos Aphrodite Festival
city_events.description: 🎭 Open-air opera near the medieval castle.

cities.name: Protaras
cities.local_food_tip: Veggie gyros, fresh salads, halloumi, oven-baked vegetables and fruit plates — ideal for a beach destination.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏖️ Fig Tree Bay: Turquoise waters + white sand. → 🌿 Coastal Nature Trail: Gentle cliffside paths. → ☕ Seaside café. 

Afternoon: 🌊 Protaras Promenade. → 🏘️ Small central streets + shops. → 🍽️ Lunch: Salads, veggie gyros, halloumi dishes. → 🌿 Green Bay Viewpoints. 

Sunset: 🌅 Cape Greco Viewpoint. 

Night: 🌃 Promenade evening walk: Ice cream stands + calm waves.
public_transport_tips: 🚌 Buses link Protaras with Ayia Napa + Paralimni.
